events.title: 그레임 수네스 resigns as manager of 블랙번 로버스 to take over at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 . He officially takes over on 13 September, after the two clubs played each other for the first time in the season.

September draws to a close with 아스널 still top of the Premier League and now two points ahead of 첼시, with 에버턴, 볼턴 원더러스 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 completing the top five. 크리스털 팰리스, 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 occupy the bottom three places. Reading have taken over as Championship leaders at the expense of 위건 애슬레틱, who now stand second. The playoff zone is occupied by 입스위치 타운, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 , 스토크 시티 and 왓퍼드 . Pre-season promotion favourites 선덜랜드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are edged out of the playoff zone on goal difference.
